verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents payout-schedule controls or a per-payout breakdown of charges, fees, and refunds. The only related item is a generic claim of 'easy reconciliations with a robust data Dashboard and easy exports', which describes adjacent reporting, not payout composition. The mention of per-currency transaction fees is likewise not about payouts.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout
